doc.title: Jimmy Owens interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001

title: Closing thoughts on loving being a musician and thanks
summary: He says he still practices and plays worldwide, feels lucky to be paid for what he loves, and the two thank each other.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well on that note, it’s a good summation of a lot of things.
It’s been very, very enjoyable for me. So I appreciate your time, and wish you the best of luck with all of your projects.
